blocks.p: Consistency on English reading (Ümit #12211): each local decision model answers the 547 kept English questions again in five forms, one request at a time on the same server as its Tool choice row. Flip rate: the share of questions whose chosen option (by its text) differs from the model's own first English run; the 'I don't know' form against its first English 'I don't know' run. Mean confidence change: the mean absolute change in the probability of the original pick. Not part of any score. Each cell: the share of the 547 questions whose pick changed; under it, the mean change in the original pick's probability. Data: consistency-reading.json.
The Turkish questions with a sixth option, “I don't know”: how often a model says it does not know instead of answering wrong.
